per_finding.notes: The literal hole is closed: pD (helper planted at $PWD/.planning/scripts/phase-lock.sh) runs nothing for claim/heartbeat/release or the stop-check peek trap; the plugin helper runs instead (p2-honest.sh: lock written, manifest kept, conflict exit 2). Plugin-root resolution uses dirname BASH_SOURCE; hooks.json and the Codex adapter invoke hooks by absolute path, so CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/PATH/cwd cannot redirect it; quoted, safe with spaces; a project scripts/phase-lock.sh is never reached. Reverting claim to $PWD makes 10+ assertions in test-phase-lock-hooks-paths.sh fail. BUT the plugin helper now runs on repository-controlled data and has two new hook-reachable holes (issues 1 and 2): arithmetic-injection RCE through multi_agent.stale_lock_ttl_seconds, and truncation of an arbitrary file through a committed .phase-locks.json.lock symlink.

Empty lock reads as {}; 'not json' and '[1,2]' make claim/heartbeat/release/peek exit 1 and the file is left untouched (test-phase-lock-plugin.sh, p2-honest.sh: claim on 'garbage{' -> helper exit 1, file unchanged); a failing jq update is refused, not written.

Owner id is runtime-host-SESSION (SB_PHASE_LOCK_SESSION); B cannot heartbeat/release A's lock; a stale-stolen lock is not touched by its old owner. Claim hook re-verifies a manifest hit with heartbeat before skipping (falls through to a real claim / conflict). SubagentStop carrying agent_id exits before touching the manifest (probe: lock and manifest kept; the parent's Stop releases). identity_tags extended to pi/goose/hermes in template, mirror, .silver-bullet.json, docs. Minor docs drift: hooks-purpose.json still says release runs at 'Stop/SubagentStop' without the agent_id exception.
pB: exec_command and Bash payloads carrying tool_input.skill record nothing; Skill tool unchanged.
pC: dangling .gitignore symlink no longer creates the victim; symlinked cache dir gets nothing written; .planning symlink and cache-file symlink also refused in code.
pB: superpowers:silver-plan, multai:silver-quality-gates, engineering:silver-secure record nothing; silver-bullet:sb:plan / silver-bullet:silver-bullet:sb:plan -> silver-plan.
pC: silver-bullet:sb:plan now produces 16678 bytes, same as bare sb:plan.

p3-adapter.sh: invoke-skill sb:release / silver-bullet:sb:release / silver-release in a project without UAT.md -> 'ERROR: skill refused by the Silver Bullet Skill gates: UAT GATE ...', nothing printed, no receipt; sb:plan prints and writes one receipt (~1.8 s). Remaining skill-root breadth judged MINOR, not major (issue 4).

issues.problem: Repository-controlled code execution, the R3-03 class again: stale_lock_ttl_seconds is read raw from the project's .silver-bullet.json (or the repo's templates/ default) and used in (( age > ttl )). Bash arithmetic evaluates the value recursively, and an array subscript runs command substitution. A repository that commits a hostile ttl plus a .planning/.phase-locks.json entry for a phase gets code run by the PreToolUse claim hook on the first Edit of a phase file, and by stop-check's peek trap at Stop. Before G4 the helper was absent downstream; G4 now ships it and runs it on every phase edit, so this is new exposure. Other G4 gates already validate numeric config (^[0-9]+$).
issues.evidence: REVF-G4-r2-probe/p1-ttl.sh: .silver-bullet.json multi_agent.stale_lock_ttl_seconds='BASH_VERSINFO[$(touch $TL_TMP/PWNED-ttl)]' + committed .planning/.phase-locks.json {"001":{...last_heartbeat_at 2026-01-01...}}; Edit payload for .planning/phases/001-x/001-PLAN.md | hooks/phase-lock-claim.sh -> rc=0, PWNED-ttl created; after rm, Stop payload | hooks/stop-check.sh with cwd .planning/phases/001-x -> PWNED-ttl created again. (A bare 'a[...]' aborts on set -u; any set variable name works.)
issues.suggested_fix: In _pl_config_get_ttl accept only ^[0-9]+$ (otherwise fall back to 1800), and drop the ${REPO_ROOT}/templates/... lookup so only the plugin's own template is used. Also validate hb_e/now_e as integers. Add a test with the hostile ttl for claim and peek (and the stop-check trap).

issues.problem: The helper follows a repository-committed symlink and destroys the target: ': > "$LOCK_SIDECAR"' and 'exec 9>"$LOCK_SIDECAR"' truncate whatever .planning/.phase-locks.json.lock points at (SEC-02 class, destructive write on the user's machine from untrusted content). Reached from the claim hook on the first Edit of a phase file in any downstream project, now that the plugin ships and runs the helper. The .tmp.$$ temp file is opened the same way (pid-dependent).
issues.evidence: REVF-G4-r2-probe/p5-symlink.sh: printf 'precious user data' > $TL_TMP/victim-rc; ln -s $TL_TMP/victim-rc .planning/.phase-locks.json.lock; commit; Edit payload | hooks/phase-lock-claim.sh -> rc=0, 'victim size: 0'. (A symlinked .phase-locks.json itself is handled: corrupt -> exit 1, then mv replaces the link.)
issues.suggested_fix: Refuse (exit 1, fail-open in the hook) when LOCK_FILE, LOCK_SIDECAR, the .tmp file or PLANNING_DIR is a symlink; create the sidecar with set -o noclobber or open it without truncation (exec 9>>), or keep the sidecar under SB_RUNTIME_STATE_DIR keyed by repo; create the temp file with mktemp in the same directory. Add a test that a symlinked sidecar's target is untouched.

issues.problem: Says release happens at Stop/SubagentStop; a SubagentStop with an agent_id now releases nothing (R3-17).
issues.suggested_fix: Mention that a subagent's SubagentStop does not release its parent session's locks; regenerate HOOKS.md.

issues.problem: Still open: the adapter's skill roots include ~/.codex/skills, ~/.agents/skills and every plugin cache, and the user-level roots come BEFORE ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills, so a same-named SKILL.md there shadows SB's and still gets an SB receipt. Judged minor, not major: a repository cannot write these home paths, the gates key on the skill name (so forbidden/UAT still apply), and an agent that can write its home gains nothing beyond loading the real skill and ignoring it (a receipt only proves 'loaded').
issues.evidence: Static: append_skill_roots order; find_skill_file returns the first match.
issues.suggested_fix: Follow-up: search ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills (and skill-source) first for silver-*/sb names, and accept other roots only for non-SB dependency skills.
